title: Machine Learning Uncovers Natural Product Modulators of the 5-Lipoxygenase Pathway and Facilitates the Elucidation of Their Biological Mechanisms.
summary: Trained classifiers selected candidates from natural-product libraries, and the abstract reports nine modulators of the 5-lipoxygenase pathway together with a new cell-type-selective mechanism. The evidence is preclinical chemical biology only.
ai_technology: Gradient-boosted trees, logistic regression and naive Bayes
organization: University of Cambridge; Friedrich Schiller University Jena; University of Lisbon

evidence.tested: Primary abstract reports nine modulators and a new cell-type-selective mechanism; Methods identify the trained selectors. Preclinical chemical biology only.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Gradient-boosted trees, logistic regression and naive Bayes is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
